[quote=equestria-atlantia;60254626][b]King or Prince?[/b]
Indeed the merger between Thýven and its southern partner of Vespurias had sent ripples into the north, while the archprince had recieved assurances from the Emperor of Elesyr that the agreements between Thýven and the principate stood as they had always stood, the Estates General were still muttering under their breath on whether it was right to remain a principate or break forward and become a kingdom in their own right. However, the question still remained that the defense mechanism of the treaty would be broken, meaning Equestria would be without sizeable armaments or defense, having been committed to external neutrality for three centuries thusfar. Indeed Elesyr-Vespurias had opened up a can of worms so sizeable in the government that a few feared the retribution of their much larger southern state, which had in their eyes to provide crown or no crown to the archprince and prince. 

Tensions thus soared in the Estates General as two camps emerged, (or perhaps three or more for politics in Equestria usually involve coalition and crossing of lines), the simplest of the camps was the pro-monarchist, who sought to crown the prince and arch-prince formally kings of Equestria, and there was the more divisive camp which sought to increase the powers of the monarchs while retaining the same powers granted by the treaty of 1675.   And what of the princes? There was silence, further aggravating the situation, silence meant uncertainty, and in Equestrian politics such a thing was dangerous. [/quote]
